instructions: Use hifi_zones for zone IDs and hifi_capabilities for provider/device support. Search or browse collections, then pass the returned ref to hifi_play_ref for exact playback. hifi_play searches and plays the first match; action=queue appends to the playback queue, not a saved playlist. For live stations, use hifi_collections action=favorites with media_type=radio; hifi_play action=radio starts Roon Radio. Spotify controls existing Connect devices. Apple Music requires a paired companion.
